privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.seo_desc: What data Nexuz uses, why, and how you can delete it.
privacy.intro: This page explains which data the Nexuz website uses and why.

p: Nexuz is a free online PDF toolbox run by an individual in Uzbekistan.

Files you upload are held only while your request is processed (in memory or in a temporary file) and are deleted right after your result is sent. Nexuz does not keep copies, does not look at the contents and does not share them.
If you create an account, we store your email address, a one-way hash of your password (we cannot read your password), the date you registered, your plan, and the sign-in sessions of your devices.

To apply daily limits we count how many operations you did today. For signed-in users the counter belongs to the account. For guests it belongs to a one-way code made from the IP address; the address itself is not saved in our database. Counters are deleted after a few days.
Nexuz sets one cookie, named nexuz_session, only after you sign in. It keeps you signed in and is not used for advertising or tracking. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.
Pages load fonts from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google servers, which receive your IP address.
Your browser also remembers your light or dark theme choice on your device (local storage). It is never sent to us.

The website runs on servers of a hosting provider that may be outside Uzbekistan and may keep technical logs (IP address, time and page address). We do not sell your data and do not share it with advertisers. We may share data if the law requires it.
You can delete your account at any time on the Account page. This deletes your account data, sign-in sessions and counters. You can also ask us by email to show or correct your data.
We may update this policy. The date at the top shows the latest version.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.seo_desc: The rules for using Nexuz: files, accounts, limits and responsibility.
terms.intro: By using the Nexuz website you accept these terms.

p: Nexuz offers online PDF tools and an Uzbek alphabet converter. You may use them for lawful purposes.

You are responsible for the files you process. Upload only files you have the right to use. Do not use Nexuz for illegal content or to harm others, and do not try to overload, attack or bypass the limits of the website.

Give a real email address, keep your password secret and tell us if you suspect misuse. You are responsible for what happens under your account. We may suspend or delete accounts that break these terms.

Daily limits and file sizes depend on your plan and are shown on the Pricing page. We may change them. Premium is not on sale yet; before any paid plan starts, its price and conditions will be published.

The tools work automatically and results can contain mistakes, especially the Uzbek alphabet converter: always check names and foreign words. Keep your original files. Nexuz is provided “as is”, without guarantee.
The free server may be slow, may sleep after inactivity or may be unavailable at times. We may change or remove features.
As far as the law allows, Nexuz and its owner are not liable for losses caused by using or not being able to use the website, including damaged or lost files.
These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
We may change these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version. Using the website after a change means you accept it.
